text: Eine wirklich gute App.Ich habe bereits meine Familie darauf hingewiesen, dass diese App wirklich entzückend ist.Die Pflanzen haben einen interessanten Namen, sind wirklich schön gestaltet und haben auch eine kleine Info. Desweiteren sind die Täglichen Belohnungen top!

developer_reply: Hi, thank you for your feedback. You can turn off the internet after starting your focus session and turn it back on when you claim your rewards. Even though we can't make the game features offline, we are planning to improve the offline mode for focus sessions. Please stay tuned!

text: It is certainly a useful app with good design. You can collect many plants so it wont be boring. You also have the option to join others in a group and plant together in deserts. There are also daily and weekly achievements that motivate, too. One thing is that you cant use apps at all or just a few (the setting you choose when you start session), so working on phone is nearly impossible but thats also why this app very good bec you cant "cheat".

text: Die App soll einem ja beim Fokussieren helfen. Im Prinzip tut sie das auch ABER sie animiert viel zu sehr zum spielen weil man seine Pflanzen gießen möchte, neue anbauen und Land erschließen kann. Das kostet alles Zeit. Zeit bei der man dann nicht auf die eigentliche Aufgabe fokussiert ist. Damit meiner Meinung nach ungeeignet und meinerseits deinstalliert.
author: Jana
developer_reply: Hi, thank you for reaching out. Focus Plant is designed to add extra focus motivation through game progression (you are more likely to return and focus if you are addicted to the gameplay). It is designed for people to have a hard time to adopt the habit. If you feel other focus apps have provided enough motivation, then the game is overkill :)

developer_reply: Hi, thank you for reaching out. Focus Plant is motivating our players through game achievements and progression. Therefore we believe the time you spend in the game play (which is minimal compare to other games) helps with adopting the habit. The ads do take some extra time but they are all optional and leave all focus functionalities 100% free.

text: I really like it and so far it really helped me to fucus. It works the way it should and it's pretty easy to figure out. Ads aren't there if you don't want to watch for extra tools. It's really nice.

text: Meine Erfahrung damit: Die App animiert zu viel zum "Spielen" und fordert immer wieder auf Werbe-Videos anzuschauen um sich Rewards zu verdienen. Das ist alles eher kontraproduktiv für meine Produktivität. Fazit: Viel zu viel drum rum. Hab die App wieder deaktiviert.
author: Raute 009
developer_reply: Hi, thank you for reaching out. We know focus game is not for everyone. 1. Play time: the app is emphasizing on gaming rewards and progression rather than punishment to motivate our users. We’ve tried to keep the total play time (without ads) minimal. 2. Ads: all ads are optional so you can access all focus and gaming functionality ads-free.
